title: Kalvium Auto Assignment Video Generator
tagline: Automated assignment explanation videos from assignment descriptions.
shortDescription: Desktop application converting assignment descriptions into AI-generated scripts, locally synthesizing voiceovers and automatically producing MP4 explanation videos.
description: Desktop application converting assignment descriptions into AI-generated scripts, locally synthesizing voiceovers and automatically producing MP4 explanation videos.

caseStudy.problem: Manually recording assignment explanation videos is repetitive and time-consuming.
caseStudy.solution: Automate the workflow from written assignment description to final MP4 by combining cloud AI script generation with local offline TTS and video encoding.
features: AI script generation via Google Gemini API
Local/offline voice synthesis using Piper TTS
caseStudy.challenges: Hybrid Electron architecture combining cloud AI generation with local media processing.
caseStudy.outcome: Packaged desktop workflow capable of generating submission-ready explanation videos.
